result: Reviewed human UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-21. POLR2A (P24928): catalytic core component of RNA polymerase II, which synthesises mRNA precursors from the four ribonucleoside triphosphates, appends one nucleotide at a time to the 3' end of the nascent RNA on the basis of complementarity with the template DNA strand, uses two Mg2+ ions, and cooperates in co-transcriptional 5'-end capping and co-transcriptional splicing. RNGTT (O60942): removes the gamma-phosphate from the 5'-triphosphate end of nascent mRNA and transfers the GMP moiety of GTP to the 5'-diphosphate end. RNMT (O43148): methylates the N7 position of the added guanosine of the 5' cap with S-adenosyl-L-methionine. PAPOLA (P51003): creates the 3' poly(A) tail of mRNAs from ATP. EIF1 (P41567): component of the 43S pre-initiation complex, which binds the cap-proximal region, scans the 5' untranslated region and locates the initiation codon; essential for start-codon recognition on the basis of AUG nucleotide context and location relative to the cap. EEF1A1 (P68104): catalyses the GTP-dependent binding of aminoacyl-tRNA to the ribosomal A site; codon-anticodon base pairing promotes GTP hydrolysis; the ribosome then forms the peptide bond. EEF2 (P13639): catalyses the GTP-dependent ribosomal translocation step. DNMT1 (P26358): methylates CpG residues, preferentially hemimethylated DNA, and associates with replication sites in S phase, maintaining the methylation pattern on the newly synthesised strand.
